# mailtrap_account (Data Source)

Reads a Mailtrap account the API token has access to. Without filters, the token must have access to exactly one account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# With access to a single account, no filters are needed.
data "mailtrap_account" "current" {}

# With access to several accounts, filter by name (or id).
data "mailtrap_account" "acme" {
  name = "Acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the account.
- `name` (String) Name of the account.

### Read-Only

- `access_levels` (List of Number) The token's access levels for the account.
